name: Merchant Email Not Populated When SIN Is Not Entered in Stipulations
description:
Steps:
1. Open an application for a new merchant in the Stipulations (pending) stage.
2. In Owner Information, complete the owner without entering a SIN.
3. Complete Stipulation Verification.

Expected: once Stipulation Verification is done, the left-panel Merchant Details show the owner's name and email.
Actual: Merchant Email stays '-', and Merchant Name is not taken from the owner. Mainly affects new merchants.

Evidence (QA, 05-11-2026): APP-2026-001304 - Business Information, Owner Identity, Banking Information, Reference Information, Bank Connect and Credit Check all verified; Merchant Details = Michael Cotic, Merchant Email '-'. APP-2026-001301 (still pending verification) shows the same empty Merchant Email.

Possible impact (not proven): on APP-2026-001304, Approve Application returned HTTP 500 on POST /kesef/api/v1/deal/auto-create and no Deal was created; a later run on a fresh application created its Deal.
